## Working agreement (read first)

Harness CLI: `npx -y @erzhe/harness-kit@latest <command>` (no global install; no `.agents/harness.lock.json` version pin yet).

Generated from `.agents/manifest.yaml`, never hand-edit: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.agents/reference.md` (plus `.agents/routing.md` / `.agents/modules.md` when declared). Edit the manifest, then run `npx -y @erzhe/harness-kit@latest sync`. Knowledge is hand-authored; `.agents/hooks/` belongs to `install-hooks`.

Before you touch code:
1. Post a **Task Brief**: what changes, change-type, files/layers touched, how you'll verify.
2. Read the relevant files before editing; do NOT full-repo grep and guess.
   Prefer `npx -y @erzhe/harness-kit@latest task-start` before editing so later commits stay in deliver scope (without it, deliver uses the worktree diff vs HEAD).

Before you finish:
3. Run `npx -y @erzhe/harness-kit@latest deliver` (checks + verify + stamp). Only `status=accepted` (or clean `no-change`) means done; on `needs-work`, fix and re-run.
4. In `NEXT ACTIONS` / `nextActions`: do every `required | agent` action yourself; ask the user only for `required | human`; defer `recommended` during unrelated work.
5. **Never claim a check you didn't run.** Informational boundaries (packaging, real network, prod upload) are not failures; mention them only when relevant.
6. Record what code can't tell an agent (gotcha, decision, fix): update the registered knowledge source in place, or add to `.agents/knowledge/` (journal ADR for decisions). Never move/copy existing repo docs to fit a folder; skip one-off noise.
